FROM PAPER TO PLACE
Find your lot in three steps.
  1. Upload a clear photo.
    We read printed text on your device. Crop to the coordinate table for better results. Handwritten or blurry text may need manual correction.
  2. Check the coordinates.
    GPS mode accepts WGS 84 latitude and longitude, in decimal degrees or DMS. Bearings mode needs a known first corner and true bearings with distances in metres. Projected easting/northing and local datums need conversion before use.
  3. Explore and export.
    Switch between satellite, streets, and a globe. Download KML to import the complete boundary into Google Earth. The Google Maps link opens the lot centre only.
Photos are not uploaded or stored. Map tiles and OCR language files require an internet connection. This tool cannot establish legal property boundaries.
